args.deps: fakes: buyables, zones, enemies, loadout, arcs, particles, economy (scripts/runShape.mjs trapsHarness)

zones.rule: zoneAt(p): the id of the first box in `boxes` (list order) with min <= p <= max on x, y and z (inclusive); "" when none. isOpen(id): id is in the open set (it starts as the session's `open`; a setOpen op replaces it).

cases.note: The four Survival traps (map.trapSpots of buildSurvival()). PLATE: enemies on its edge, one ulp outside, at reachUp, a boss, a rival (ignored), its tick every S(every); its cooldown; debugFire; CRUSHER: drops at S(drop) of each S(every), dy 2.4 / 2.5; FAN: launch once per activation, the delayed kill (a dead enemy's is skipped), a kill still pending when the fan stops (kept, resumed by the next activation); PYLON: up to 4 targets, nearest first by 3D distance (ties keep spawn order: stable sort), one at the range (inside), dy = reachUp (outside). Then clear, reload, debugFire, load(null). Ops: load [map] (traps.load(map); map is {trapSpots} or null), clear [], setOpen [ids], spawn [{id, kind, isBoss, hp, position, aimHeight}], move [id, [x, y, z]], killEnemy [id] (alive = false, as a kill by something else), available [trap] (result: the buyable's available()), buy [trap] (the buyable's buy()), debugFire [trap] (result), step [dt] (traps.step(dt)), stepN [dt, n] (n steps; each call in after.calls carries at: the 1-based step inside the op). after: calls (in order: buyablesAdd {id, kind, name, position, reach, price}, buyablesRemove {id}, zoneAt {p, result}, isOpen {id, result}, damage {enemy, amount, headshot, weapon, from, assisted, pointScale, opts, killed}, launch {enemy, speed}, arc {from, to, hex, intensity, life, jag, width}, burst {position, colorHex, count, speed, life, scale}, event {name, payload}), items (per trap in load order: id, zone, active, cooldown, tick (steps), thrown (enemy ids, insertion order), pending [{enemy, steps}]), stats (traps.stats), enemies [{id, hp, alive, position}].
